historical_allocation.formation_shortfall_rule: fewer than 385 structurally eligible FORMATION rows or fewer than 20 effective FORMATION dates
historical_allocation.selection_shortfall_rule: fewer than 5 effective SELECTION dates or fewer than 100 effective SELECTION rows

class_meanings.FEES: current forward fee regime for the daily-rain market family
class_meanings.RESOLUTION_RULES: current station / CLI / threshold / climate-day / finality semantics
class_meanings.TICK_SIZE_MIN_ORDER: current tick and minimum-order constraints plus available tick-change history

candidate_plan.missing_data_policy: Before any label access a row is excluded with a closed reason when B0 is unavailable (the row leaves B0, B1 and B2 alike) or any declared B1/B2 feature is unavailable; no imputation, no fallback feature, no canonical PIT relabeling.

mkt.ext_b0_probability_v1.value_rule: the frozen EXTERNAL_PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 B0 value of the same row

time.ndfd_lead_hours_v1.value_rule: L = (climate_day_start - vintage_public_available_time) / 24h, exact seconds divided by 86400; climate_day_start is target-date midnight in the rule-bound station local standard time; vintage_public_available_time is the public availability of the same vintage used for q; L may be negative

wx.ndfd_pop12_max_climate_day_v1.grid_rule: rule-bound station coordinate; ecCodes nearest grid point within 10 km
wx.ndfd_pop12_max_climate_day_v1.source: NOAA NDFD CONUS PoP12 (noaa-ndfd-pds wmo/pop12), OFFICIAL_HISTORICAL_EXPORT
wx.ndfd_pop12_max_climate_day_v1.value_rule: q = clip(max PoP12_percent / 100 over the vintage's PoP12 periods whose valid interval overlaps the rule-bound target climate day, 0.01, 0.99)
wx.ndfd_pop12_max_climate_day_v1.vintage_rule: latest NDFD PoP12 object whose public availability (conservative S3 LastModified bound) lies in [decision_time - 172800 s, decision_time]; GRIB reference/valid time never substitutes availability

b0_mechanics.book_rule: latest Yes-token best_bid_ask with capture timestamp_received <= decision_time inside the 24-hour market-history lookback
b0_mechanics.last_trade_rule: otherwise B0 = the latest observed Yes-token last_trade_price with timestamp_received <= decision_time and decision_time - timestamp_received <= max_last_trade_age_seconds
b0_mechanics.midpoint_rule: B0 = (bid + ask) / 2 only for a valid two-sided book (both present, 0 <= bid <= ask <= 1) with spread <= max_midpoint_spread
b0_mechanics.spread_rule: spread = ask - bid, recomputed; source spread fields are never trusted

candidate_plan.calibration_diagnostic: Reliability over 10 equal-width probability bins with Murphy decomposition (reliability, resolution, uncertainty); diagnostic only.

forecast_model_spec.fit_failed_consequence: OOS evidence invalid; hypothesis not supported; no refit
forecast_model_spec.implementation_parity_rule: any later implementation or library is admissible only when deterministic parity tests prove it implements these frozen mathematical semantics
forecast_model_spec.objective: maximize sum_i [y_i*ln(pi_i) + (1 - y_i)*ln(1 - pi_i)] + 0.5*ln(det(I(beta))), I(beta) = X' W X, W = diag(pi_i*(1 - pi_i))
forecast_model_spec.oos_forecast_rule: formation-fitted coefficients applied unchanged to OOS rows; p1 and p2 scored as produced

solver.fit_failed_rule: FIT_FAILED on a non-finite coefficient, a singular information matrix or no convergence by iteration 100
solver.hat_diagonal: h_i = i-th diagonal of W^(1/2) X (X' W X)^(-1) X' W^(1/2)
solver.modified_score: U*_j(beta) = sum_i (y_i - pi_i + h_i*(1/2 - pi_i)) * x_ij
solver.step: delta = I(beta_k)^(-1) U*(beta_k); beta_{k+1} = beta_k + delta (full step)

candidate_plan.falsifiable_claim: On genuinely prospective NWS-resolved Polymarket daily-rain target dates, the prespecified weather-only B1 forecast must improve out-of-sample Brier loss versus contemporaneous market probability B0, the combined B2 forecast must improve versus B0, and B2 must add incremental predictive information versus B1 under the frozen comparison family.
candidate_plan.falsification_condition: The hypothesis is not supported if the preregistered prospective-OOS experiment fails its frozen absolute Brier criterion or any required fixed-sequence B1-vs-B0, B2-vs-B0 or B2-vs-B1 comparison, or if the OOS evidence is invalid/inconclusive.
candidate_plan.proposed_mechanism: Official NWS precipitation forecasts contain public non-market meteorological information that may not be fully incorporated into contemporaneous Polymarket probability; forecast lead time captures horizon-dependent calibration, while market probability may contribute complementary crowd information.
candidate_plan.review_assertion: Reviewed and authorized by the project owner before prospective OOS accrual.

candidate_plan.availability_time_rule: The label is available at the later of Gamma closedTime and the capture timestamp_received of the agreeing v3 market_resolved evidence; label evidence is post-outcome evidence and never enters B0 or feature evidence.
candidate_plan.censoring_rule: A market whose agreeing final-label evidence has not reached a terminal classification is PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY, an accrual state and not an exclusion, with no elapsed-time timeout; a failed label source read and identity, rule or source-disagreement failures are excluded with the closed DATA-01/DATA-02 label exclusion codes; no imputation.
candidate_plan.horizon_rule: From the row checkpoint (MARKET_OBSERVABLE_PLUS_60M_V1 or TARGET_CLIMATE_DAY_START_V1) to final market resolution.
candidate_plan.outcome_source_rule: The final Gamma outcome and the PendulumFlow v3 market_resolved evidence must agree on winning token and outcome under the rule-bound finality policy (FIRST_PUBLISHED_FINAL, LATEST_BEFORE_2359_ET or LAST_BEFORE_1400_ET); disagreement or absence excludes the market.
candidate_plan.prediction_target: Binary Yes outcome of an NWS-resolved Polymarket daily-rain market: Yes iff the rule-bound NWS Daily Climate Report (CLI) precipitation for the rule-bound station and climate day is >= 0.01 inch; trace does not count.
candidate_plan.target_time_rule: End of the rule-bound target climate day: midnight to midnight local standard time of the rule-bound station (the DATA-02 climate-day rule).

label_plan.label_pending_rule: a prospective market without terminal agreeing Gamma/v3 final-label evidence is PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY: not an eligible OOS row, not counted toward D1..D50, exposes no label or outcome value, and never becomes LABEL_GAMMA_NOT_FINAL merely because time has passed

provenance_context.alpha_family_falsifiable_theme: Under point-in-time-safe testing, official NWS public weather information fails to add reproducible out-of-sample predictive information beyond contemporaneous Polymarket probability.
provenance_context.research_question: Are contract-specific official NWS precipitation forecasts and observations for Polymarket daily-rain markets sufficiently repeatable, point-in-time observable and falsifiable to justify later deterministic testing of whether public non-market weather information adds predictive information beyond contemporaneous Polymarket market probability?

builder_inputs.af1_gate_receipt: the committed S10-GATE-AF1 receipt whose id equals lineage.af1_gate_receipt_id
builder_inputs.alpha_registry_snapshot: the verified S10-ALPHA-REAL-01 registry snapshot whose head equals lineage.alpha_registry_head_entry_hash

MR01_INFORMATION_CUTOFF_V1.rule: ceiling to the whole UTC second of the maximum of every bound provenance-manifest information_cutoff, the governing episode research_as_of and every bound execution-evidence capture time

MR02_PROVENANCE_MANIFESTS_V1.rule: exactly the ready-subset ResearchProvenanceManifests of the DATA-02 formation and selection target dates and of the DATA-03 OOS membership dates D1..D50; more than 256 is the terminal QUAL_PROVENANCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (no aggregation, substitution or omission)

MR03_CREATION_PROVENANCE_V1.rule: S10-QUAL-REAL-01 candidate from S10-QUAL-PLAN-01 plan sha256 <plan sha256> merged at <merge commit sha>; DATA-03 bundle <data03 bundle id>; OOS membership <oosmembership id>

MR04_FEATURE_EVIDENCE_REFS_V1.rule: for each feature ref exactly the sorted pair [DATA-03 bundle id, DATA-03 sealed feature-column id of that ref]

MR05_LABEL_EVIDENCE_REFS_V1.rule: exactly the sorted pair [DATA-03 bundle id, DATA-03 sealed label-store id]

MR06_DATASET_REFS_V1.rule: sorted unique union of the dataset_refs (external dataset descriptor ids) carried by the MR02 manifests; never a DatasetSnapshotReference record and never relabelled canonical PIT

MR07_FORMATION_START_V1.rule: earliest decision_time of any row of the FORMATION target dates allocated by MR14, floored to the whole UTC second

MR08_SELECTION_START_V1.rule: earliest decision_time of any row of the first SELECTION target date allocated by MR14, floored to the whole UTC second; a FORMATION-date row at or after it is excluded as ROLE_BOUNDARY_CROSSING_EXCLUDED

MR09_END_TIME_V1.rule: maximum decision_time over the OOS membership rows truncated to the whole UTC second, plus 1 second

MR10_OOS_ROW_COUNT_V1.rule: number of oos_row_ids in the sealed OOS membership

MR11_OOS_DATE_COUNT_V1.rule: number of oos_target_dates in the sealed OOS membership (50 when sealed)

MR12_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE_STATE_V1.rule: AVAILABLE iff every required capture of the class meets all available_criteria; PARTIAL iff at least one but not all do; MISSING iff none do; NOT_APPLICABLE is never used; evidence_reference_ids are the sorted DATA-03 capture ids of the qualifying captures (empty for MISSING)

MR13_OOS_MEMBERSHIP_V1.rule: a DATA-03 target date is considered when every included row decision_time is < cap; it is OOS-eligible iff it has at least one eligible row and every included row decision_time is >= oos_start and >= oos_start + embargo_seconds (the WP170 embargo zone), every required condition is structurally classified and every market that could affect it has a terminal label-eligibility classification (no PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY); D1..D50 are the chronologically first 50 terminally eligible dates, sealed only when no earlier in-window date at or before D50 is still pending

MR14_HISTORICAL_ROLE_ALLOCATION_V1.rule: eligible historical dates are DATA-02 target dates with at least one evidence-complete row whose B0 and features are available; the last 7 in date order are SELECTION, all earlier are FORMATION; effective counts are taken after the WP170 purge and embargo

MR15_WP170_SAMPLE_SET_V1.rule: the future WP170 ResearchDatasetManifest samples are exactly the MR14 FORMATION and SELECTION rows that survive every closed exclusion (including ROLE_BOUNDARY_CROSSING_EXCLUDED) plus the sealed oos_row_ids; no other DATA-02 or DATA-03 row (excluded-date rows, rows of dates after D50, rows before oos_start) ever enters the WP170 split

eligibility.cap_rule: the cap limits which target dates may enter this plan and is not a label-resolution timeout; after the cap no new target date enters, already considered in-window dates may remain PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY, DATA-03 may keep checking only the evidence needed to terminally classify them, and no fit, score, coefficient, prevalence, outcome summary or comparison statistic is exposed while waiting
eligibility.pending_date_rule: a considered target date with any required market still PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY remains pending; a pending date is never skipped and a later date never takes its prefix position
eligibility.prefix_stability_rule: D1..D50 are the chronologically first 50 terminally eligible target dates; the seal may be created only when no earlier in-window target date at or before D50 remains PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY

membership_seal.id_rule: oosmembership:sha256: + sha256 of the canonical JSON bytes (UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no floats) of the preimage
membership_seal.oos_exclusions_scope: every considered-date market, row and date exclusion from the first considered date through D50
membership_seal.ordering: oos_target_dates ascending; oos_row_ids ascending; oos_exclusions ascending by (target_date, subject_kind, subject_id)

terminals.accrual_incomplete_rule: while the first-50 chronological prefix is not yet stable (fewer than 50 terminally eligible dates, or an earlier in-window date still PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY); structural counts only
terminals.insufficient_at_cap_rule: fewer than 50 stable eligible dates once every in-window target date is terminally classified; never issued while an earlier in-window pending date could still change the first-50 prefix; no extension, no S10-QUAL-REAL-01, no score; a new attempt needs a new plan, family, trial and later prospective boundary
terminals.oos_rows_insufficient_rule: a sealed 50-date membership with fewer than 100 oos_row_ids: no S10-QUAL-REAL-01, no score, no extension
terminals.seal_rule: at least 50 stable terminally eligible dates: seal the chronologically first D1..D50 once no earlier in-window target date at or before D50 remains PENDING_LABEL_FINALITY

candidate_plan.power_method: Target-date clustered one-sided paired loss-difference design: n = ceil((1 + 2*rho1) * (((z_{1-alpha} + z_{power}) / dz)^2 + z_{1-alpha}^2 / 2)) with alpha 0.025 one-sided, power 0.8, dz 0.5 and rho1 0.25, giving 50 effective target dates; development sufficiency (Riley criterion iii, 385 formation rows) is documented separately from OOS comparison power in docs/qualification_plans/S10-QUAL-PLAN-01/power_analysis_v1.md.

absolute_criterion.aggregation: mean over D1..D50 of the per-date mean row-level Brier score

candidate_plan.multiplicity_method: Fixed-sequence one-sided testing controlling FWER at 0.025 over target-date clustered Brier differentials: B2 vs B0, then B2 vs B1, then B1 vs B0, each at one-sided alpha 0.025; a later comparison is confirmatory only if every preceding comparison rejects.

test_family_plan.per_date_differential: d_t = mean over the eligible rows of date t of (Brier(candidate) - Brier(comparator))
test_family_plan.rejection_rule: reject iff V > 0 and DM <= -t_{0.975, n-1} (Student t quantile, n - 1 = 49 degrees of freedom)
test_family_plan.statistic_rule: dates D1..D50 in chronological order; dbar = mean(d_t); gamma_k = (1/n) * sum_{t>k} (d_t - dbar) * (d_{t-k} - dbar); V = gamma_0 + gamma_1 (Bartlett weight 1/2 at lag 1); DM = dbar / sqrt(V / n); n = 50
test_family_plan.support_rule: supported only if the OOS evidence is valid, the absolute criterion holds and all three comparisons reject in the fixed sequence; otherwise not supported

known_later_dependency.reason: current WP170 FeatureDefinition source dependencies cannot encode the NDFD B1 features
